title: Aegrit
extract:
Aegrit are Grineer throwing bombs that stick to surfaces and can be remotely detonated with Alternate Fire. Its extremely high  Blast damage, Critical Chance and explosion radius are offset by a very low ammo capacity.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Blast damage.
Mines can stick to surfaces, including enemies and allies.
Extra projectiles generated by Multishot have a very wide horizontal spread, effective at covering large groups of enemies.
Can only have four deployed mines out at once.
Extra projectiles generated by Multishot will count towards this limit.
User can detonate charges on command via Alternate Fire, giving the player precise timing in detonation.
Detonation has an explosion radius of 9 meters.
Up to four deployed mines can be ready for simultaneous detonation.
Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls.
Can benefit from  Fulmination ( Primed).
Advantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Pinpoint accuracy.
Silent, even if the projectile hits the enemy.

Disadvantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Projectiles have very slow travel time with arcing.
Semi-automatic fire, unlike other throwing weapons.
Explosions inflict self-stagger.
Explosions have a headshot multiplier of 1x and cannot trigger headshot conditions.
Explosion has linear Damage Falloff from 100% to 30% from central impact.
Extremely low magazine size of just 2 rounds; requires frequent reloading.
Low ammo capacity size of 4.
Only restores one unit of ammunition per ammo pickup.

Acquisition
Aegrit's blueprint is available from Chipper of Kahl's Garrison for 30  Stock, requiring players to be at Rank 4 - Settlement to purchase.

Known Bugs
 Galvanized Shot is multiplicative to base damage sources on direct hits.
Can be equipped with  Concealed Explosives despite being an explosive weapon, but the mod has no effect.

Trivia
These throwing bombs appear to integrate Orokin technology, similarly to the  Seer and  Twin Rogga.
